header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: OpenAEC Docs
header.desc: Open source BIM document management platform. Manage, share and archive all project documents in one central place.

what.title: What is OpenAEC Docs?
what.desc: OpenAEC Docs is a document management system (DMS) specifically designed for BIM projects in the construction industry. It is based on Nextcloud — the most popular open source platform for file management and collaboration. It provides a central place for managing, sharing and archiving all project documents — from drawings and reports to contracts and permits.
what.tech: Built on Nextcloud with additional Rust and TypeScript modules for BIM-specific functionality.

documents.title: Document management
documents.desc: Upload, organize and search documents by project, discipline or phase. Automatic metadata extraction.

versioning.title: Version control
versioning.desc: Complete version history of every document. Compare versions and restore previous revisions.

ifcx.title: IFCX integration
ifcx.desc: Link documents to IFCX model elements. View related documents directly from the BIM model.

access.title: Access control
access.desc: Role-based permissions per project and folder. Determine who can view, edit or delete documents.

search.title: Search & filter
search.desc: Full-text search through documents and metadata. Filter by type, date, author or status.

api.title: API & integration
api.desc: REST API for integration with other tools in the OpenAEC ecosystem. Webhooks for automation.

highlight.title: Self-hosted & privacy-first
highlight.desc: OpenAEC Docs runs on your own server via Docker. Full control over your data, no cloud dependency. Ideal for organizations with strict privacy and compliance requirements.
